title: Get started
content:
Get started

Use your own Cloudflare account. Clone the repository. Follow Start here for the checked path. There is no one-click installer for a single site yet (#401).

Read first: Start here, then limits, then plugins and themes.

What you need (one site, built-in database)

  • A Cloudflare account. Workers Paid is $5 a month. Workers Free can run plain WordPress and a light storefront on b-dosql.
  • macOS or Linux (Windows: use WSL).
  • git, Node.js 22 or later, Terraform 1.5 or later, Python 3.11 or later, curl, zip, unzip, lsof.
  • An API token with Workers Scripts Edit, Workers R2 Storage Edit, and Account Settings Read.
  • R2 turned on for the account if you want MEDIA=1.

Install one site

git clone https://github.com/skyphusion-labs/pagefeather.git
cd pagefeather
export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=...
export ACCOUNT_ID=...
VARIANT=b-dosql MEDIA=1 BENCH=0 NAME=my-site ./deploy/deploy.sh

The script prints the site address. On our test machine (Linux, 4 CPUs) this took about 90 seconds.

Admin password

cd deploy/terraform
terraform workspace select my-site
terraform output -raw admin_password

Keep that password safe. The folder deploy/terraform/terraform.tfstate.d/ holds site secrets. Do not share it or put it in git.

Many sites

Use deploy/wfp on Workers for Platforms Paid. Flow: operator.md. We measured site add and site remove from a clean checkout of main.

export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=...
export ACCOUNT_ID=...
export SITES="blog"
./deploy/wfp/up.sh
./deploy/wfp/site add shop
./deploy/wfp/site list

Real store (MySQL)

Use VARIANT=a with MYSQL=external or MYSQL=vultr, plus PLACEMENT. Step-by-step MySQL page is open (#1365). Today: onboarding and the deploy reference.

VARIANT=a MYSQL=external \
  MYSQL_HOST=mysql.example.com \
  MYSQL_USER=wp \
  MYSQL_PASSWORD=... \
  MYSQL_DATABASE=wordpress \
  PLACEMENT=azure:westus2 \
  NAME=my-site ./deploy/deploy.sh

After install

  • Site: https://my-site.YOUR-SUBDOMAIN.workers.dev (deploy prints the real address)
  • wp-admin: add /wp-admin/. User name is admin.
  • Coming from a LAMP host? Read from-lamp.md first.
  • Remove a site with deploy/destroy.sh. That cannot be undone. To delete the media bucket on purpose, set DESTROY_MEDIA=1.
